data.gender_notes: Naumaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Naumaan means 'giver of good news' or 'comforter'. It is a name of prophet Nuh (Noah) in the Quran, who was a helper and a source of comfort for his people during the great flood. The name is deeply rooted in the spiritual significance of providing solace and support during times of need. The name Naumaan carries the meaning “Comforter, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naumaan usually hope their child will grow to embody comforter, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
